basics.name: Paul Gebheim
basics.label: Product Architect & Engineering Leader
basics.summary: Product architect and engineering leader with 20 years building software across distributed systems, crypto infrastructure, and applied AI — from real-time analytics at Justin.tv, to the first prediction market on Ethereum, to ZK at Polygon. Currently running incubations at Sei Labs.

work.name: Sei Labs
highlights: Lead Sei's incubations arm; helped found and launch multiple enterprises.
Neuromorphic Labs — founding team; raised $5M from Flying Fish Ventures.
EICO (acoco.ai) — founding engineer & team lead; architected and built the full multi-tenant, company-running agent loop platform; delivered V1.
Monaco (0xmonaco.com) — oversaw the engineering team for the initial build.
Alpha (tradealpha.app) — manage the engineering team building the product.

work.name: Polygon Technology
highlights: Rolled out the Type-1 zkEVM prover — full Ethereum-equivalence proofs for real mainnet blocks at $0.002–0.003/tx (~36x cheaper than competing provers), covered by CoinDesk and Blockworks.
Architecture and design for AggLayer and Polygon blockchain infrastructure; architecture lead for Katana Blockchain (spun off from Polygon).
Co-authored PIP-18 (Polygon 2.0 Phase 0 — Frontier) and PIP-42 (upgrade PoS staking to POL).

work.name: Dapper Labs
highlights: Led the Flow blockchain governance team; authored FLIP-1057: Automated Slot Assignment (implemented) and edited FLIP-GOV-1: Maintain Staking Rewards.
Published the Flow Access Architecture Specification and led milestone delivery for permissionless contract deployment and segmented transaction fees (FLIP-660).

work.name: Augur Project
highlights: Led backend engineering for Augur V1 — the first prediction market platform live on Ethereum.
Owned the full end-to-end architecture for Augur V2.

work.name: Swoop, Inc
highlights: Shipped tow-truck dispatch software; integrated the platform with a third-party data provider, opening job flow from insurance companies and motor clubs.
Owned research, architecture, and testing for the Rails backend; supported live customer issues.
Swoop was acquired by Agero.

work.name: Monkey Inferno
highlights: Built Beerhunt — iOS beer social network ("Foursquare for beer"), launched at DEMO Mobile 2013.
Built Blab — 1-to-many group live-video social network.
Built Water Forward — viral pay-it-forward fundraising engine for charity: water.

work.name: Justin.tv
highlights: Maintained and replaced legacy statistics system; implemented a log analytics framework on Hadoop Map/Reduce.
Created a real-time discrete event tracking system on MongoDB — presented at MongoSF.
Built Beancounter, a web front-end for visualizing time-series statistics, plus JavaScript libraries for user tracking and log generation.
Implemented an iPhone push notification provider system.

work.name: Coral8, Inc
highlights: Built core components of the Complex Event Processing engine in C++: high-speed data bus, pub/sub queuing, reliable persistent transport.
Designed and implemented SOAP/HTTP RPC layers, remote-database caching, and ACL-based client/server security.
Designed persistent data structures on a SQLite-based persistence engine; helped build the high-speed query execution engine.
Coral8 merged with Aleri and was acquired by Sybase (now SAP).

work.name: University of Wisconsin–Madison
highlights: Supported public and private network access for hotel guests and UW staff.
Designed and optimized a marketing data warehouse; built ASP.NET front-ends and automated data synchronization from external stores.
Maintained VB/database financial applications and custom ASP/ASP.NET apps for student data and course enrollment.
